```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
import json

# Period data
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 42, "setup_cost": 106, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "2": {"demand": 46, "setup_cost": 113, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "3": {"demand": 46, "setup_cost": 407, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "4": {"demand": 26, "setup_cost": 346, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "5": {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 481, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "6": {"demand": 49, "setup_cost": 295, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "7": {"demand": 36, "setup_cost": 243, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "8": {"demand": 47, "setup_cost": 391, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "9": {"demand": 47, "setup_cost": 184, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "10": {"demand": 12, "setup_cost": 325, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "11": {"demand": 30, "setup_cost": 437, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "12": {"demand": 48, "setup_cost": 273, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "13": {"demand": 15, "setup_cost": 417, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "14": {"demand": 17, "setup_cost": 357, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "15": {"demand": 34, "setup_cost": 367, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4}
}

# Capacity per period
capacity = {
    "1": 56, "2": 32, "3": 46, "4": 33, "5": 46,
    "6": 36, "7": 33, "8": 47, "9": 47, "10": 16,
    "11": 34, "12": 68, "13": 11, "14": 25, "15": 49
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("lot_sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Sets
periods = list(period_data.keys())

# Variables
production = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Objective
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[p]["setup_cost"] * setup[p] +
        period_data[p]["prod_cost"] * production[p] +
        period_data[p]["holding_cost"] * inventory[p]
        for p in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Constraints
for i, p in enumerate(periods):
    # Demand constraint
    if i == 0:
        model.addConstr(production[p] == period_data[p]["demand"] + inventory[p])
    else:
        prev_p = periods[i - 1]
        model.addConstr(production[p] + inventory[prev_p] == period_data[p]["demand"] + inventory[p])
    
    # Capacity constraint
    model.addConstr(production[p] <= capacity[p] * setup[p])

    # Non-negativity of inventory
    model.addConstr(inventory[p] >= 0)

# Solve the model
model.optimize()

# Prepare the output
solution = {
    "production": {p: int(production[p].X) for p in periods},
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

# Print the solution as JSON
print(json.dumps(solution))
```
